external_entities.name: calling service
external_entities.description: A backend operated by another product team that calls the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: The description refers to two calling services in a different cloud but gives no distinguishing names, so they are represented as one external-system element.

external_entities.name: ML engineers
external_entities.description: People who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server, while writing requests and responses to an inference log.
processes.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes, loads model artifacts, and reads customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which the model server loads model artifacts and to which ML engineers publish new model artifacts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_stores.notes: The description says the artifact integrity is trusted and does not state that anything verifies the artifact has not been swapped.

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The features include account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that users sometimes typed.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging.
data_stores.notes: The log includes raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.
